extracted.name: Cocktail club oysters
extracted.description: Top your seafood starter with preserved lemon, bitters and orange juice for a citrus-spiked oyster feast. No one could resist these sophisticated bites
instruction_lines: Combine the lemon, bitters and orange juice in a bowl. Spoon the mixture over the freshly shucked oysters and serve immediately.
